name: clayzo-animation-authoring
title: clayzo-animation-authoring
description: Agent-first interactive animation authoring: write motion graphics as code, frame-check every frame with clayzo review, and ship live on the web or natively in Swift.
why: A genuinely distinct capability no existing entry covers: live interactive animation documents (WebGL/CanvasKit, native Swift) with agent frame-level self-review — a different artifact from Remotion's rendered video and Hyperframes' HTML-to-MP4. Link-only: the skills repo declares no license (cannot vendor) and the engine is proprietary (Clayzo SDK License v1.0; Node.js 22.13+ and account sign-in required).
